differentiators.sectionTitle: Three things other chat tools don't do
differentiators.sectionSubtitle: Sukhan was built for a market most chat tools ignore. Here's what that means in practice.

transparent.title: Transparent AI pricing
transparent.body: No metered AI charges. No per-resolution fees. Every plan has a fixed monthly AI action quota — when you hit the cap, the AI gracefully steps aside and your human agents take over. You'll never get a surprise bill.

selfHost.title: Actually self-hostable
selfHost.body: One docker compose up command. AGPL-3.0 means you can run Sukhan on your own server, for your own customers, with no license fee. The full source is yours to inspect, modify, and audit.

bilingual.title: Bilingual from day one
bilingual.body: Persian RTL isn't bolted on — it's a first-class locale. The agent dashboard, the widget, the AI prompts, and the emails all switch between Persian and English without reloading. Your visitors see what they expect to see.

ctaStrip.title: From signup to a live widget in under five minutes.
ctaStrip.body: Create a workspace, paste one script tag, start chatting. Free forever for small teams.

features.title: Built for the conversations that actually happen.
features.subtitle: Every feature here exists because a real customer-support team asked for it. No filler.

realtime.title: Real-time chat
realtime.body: Sub-second message delivery over a Socket.IO transport. Typing indicators, read receipts, presence, file attachments. The inbox handles hundreds of concurrent conversations without breaking a sweat.

faq.title: AI FAQ auto-responder
faq.body: Drop in the questions your visitors actually ask. Our LLM classifier matches new questions against your FAQ list above a confidence threshold — when it's sure, it answers; when it isn't, it stays quiet and routes to a human.

productQa.title: Product Q&A
productQa.body: Sync your product catalog from WooCommerce (Shopify + Basalam coming soon) or import a CSV. The AI answers product questions using only your data — no hallucination, no invented prices.

routing.title: Routing rules
routing.body: Send conversations to the right agent automatically. Route by keyword, by department, by visitor language, or by time of day. Rules are evaluated in order, the first match wins, and you can reorder them by drag-and-drop.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: See your volume, response times, and CSAT trends at a glance. Filter by department or agent. Export to CSV. No dashboards-of-dashboards — just the numbers that matter.

csat.title: CSAT surveys
csat.body: After every conversation, the widget asks the visitor one question: how did we do? The score lands in analytics within seconds. Set the survey text per-language.

widget.title: Widget customization
widget.body: Your widget, your brand. Pick the accent color, the launcher shape (tab / rounded / pill), the position (bottom-start or bottom-end), the agent avatar, the logo, and the greeting — separately for Persian and English.

billing.title: Iran-first billing
billing.body: Pay in Toman via ZarinPal, IDPay, or ZarinLink. No Stripe, no foreign currency, no SWIFT. Plans are flat-rate — if you hit a cap, the feature gracefully degrades instead of charging you more.

whySelfHost.title: Data sovereignty
whySelfHost.body: Your customer conversations stay on your server. Nothing leaves your infrastructure unless you want it to.

whySelfHost.title: No per-seat cost ceiling
whySelfHost.body: Add as many agents as you want. There's no license fee, no per-seat billing, no usage metering.

whySelfHost.title: Full source audit
whySelfHost.body: Read every line. Modify anything. The AGPL-3.0 guarantees you always have the right to inspect and modify the code.

whySelfHost.title: Custom integrations
whySelfHost.body: Hook Sukhan into your internal systems. Build custom connectors. Modify the AI prompts to fit your domain.

cta.title: Want help self-hosting?
cta.body: The Enterprise plan includes a self-hosting license with priority support. Or fork the repo and run it yourself — both are valid.
